consequence.statement: Clusters using a remote/external control plane must install with the istiod chart and --set profile=remote instead of the istiod-remote chart, and must also install the istio-base chart.
consequence.remediation: Use `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote` and install istio-base in both local and remote clusters.

assertion.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart is replaced by the istiod chart installed with --set profile=remote; remote-control-plane clusters must install this way.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence does not state a detectable configuration for installs using the istiod-remote chart; chart choice at install time is not expressible by available predicates.
